skill.name: legal-advisor
skill.description: Draft technology legal documents, privacy notices, compliance checklists, and attorney review notes for software, SaaS, and online businesses.
skill.summary: Create practical legal document templates for privacy, terms, cookies, data processing, and compliance workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Teams need clear legal templates for software products and data practices. This skill drafts structured documents and flags areas for attorney review.
actual_capabilities: Drafts privacy policies, terms of service, cookie policies, and data processing agreements.
Creates jurisdiction-aware sections for GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, PIPEDA, COPPA, and email marketing rules.
Adds disclaimers, liability limits, intellectual property notices, and licensing language.
Produces implementation notes for consent, tracking, age gates, and data handling workflows.
Includes compliance checklists and attorney review flags for unresolved legal questions.
limitations: It provides informational templates and does not replace advice from a qualified attorney.
It depends on accurate business details, data flows, jurisdictions, and product requirements.
It cannot guarantee that laws, regulator guidance, or enforcement priorities are current.
It cannot negotiate, file, or formally approve legal documents.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS Product
use_cases.description: Draft privacy, terms, cookie, and user agreement sections before product launch.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Updates
use_cases.description: Compare required disclosures against new data collection, tracking, or marketing workflows.

use_cases.title: Create Attorney Review Packs
use_cases.description: Organize draft clauses, assumptions, open questions, and review notes for legal counsel.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Privacy Policy
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a first policy draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a privacy policy for a SaaS product. Ask for any missing business details before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Create Terms of Service
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard document drafting for an online service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create terms of service for a subscription software product. Include account rules, payments, acceptable use, IP, liability, and termination.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Cookie Compliance Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for website tracking disclosures.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a cookie policy and implementation checklist for analytics, advertising pixels, consent banners, and user preference controls.

prompt_templates.title: Map Multi-Jurisdiction Obligations
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and PIPEDA compliance matrix for our data flows, processors, retention periods, and user rights.

output_examples.input: Draft a privacy policy for a B2B analytics SaaS serving EU and California users.
output_examples.output: A structured privacy policy with data categories, purposes, legal bases, sharing, retention, user rights, cookies, international transfers, and review notes.

output_examples.input: Create a DPA outline for a company that processes customer CRM records.
output_examples.output: A data processing agreement outline covering processor duties, sub-processors, security measures, audits, breach notice, return or deletion, and attorney review items.

output_examples.input: Review our cookie practices for an e-commerce site using analytics and ads.
output_examples.output: A cookie policy draft, consent checklist, tracker categories, banner requirements, opt-out notes, and jurisdiction-specific warnings.

best_practices: Provide product details, jurisdictions, data categories, processors, retention periods, and user groups.
Ask for assumptions, missing inputs, and attorney review notes in every final document.
Review generated templates against current law and company practices before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated legal text without qualified legal review.
Do not request one generic policy for all jurisdictions without explaining your user locations.
Do not hide unclear data practices behind vague legal language.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It creates informational templates and review notes. A qualified attorney should review final documents.

faq.question: Which documents can it draft?
faq.answer: It can draft privacy policies, terms of service, cookie policies, DPAs, disclaimers, IP notices, and compliance checklists.

faq.question: Which regulations does it reference?
faq.answer: It references GDPR, CCPA or CPRA, LGPD, PIPEDA, UK data protection law, COPPA, CAN-SPAM, CASL, and ePrivacy rules.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide business details, product features, user locations, collected data, vendors, retention periods, marketing practices, and contact details.

faq.question: Can it update documents for new laws?
faq.answer: It can help structure updates, but current legal research and attorney review are still required.

faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
